events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and iconic British singer Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite track from the iconic rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The powerful message of peace and unity still resonates today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago, this little device changed everything for music lovers. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, what's your favourite Bond moment or song? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece with so many unforgettable tracks. Which one is on repeat for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly pushed boundaries. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a voice for peace and a musical visionary whose influence continues to resonate globally. His spirit lives on through his songs.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary artist David Bowie.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King, Elvis Presley, on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His music and charisma changed the world forever. What's your go-to Elvis track?
